title: comfy nodes widget-catalog
description: Derived object_info metadata for positional widget serialization and grow families. widget_layout retains all dynamic selector branches and structural field identities; widget_order is the first-choice display order only. No types, defaults or ordinary enum choices are included.

layout.description: Current-frontend serialized slots in semantic order, not a list of writable fields. A selector consumes its own value, then the matching option's widgets, then the following sibling. Injected upload/audioUI controls consume no value and are excluded; seed companions and PREVIEW_3D image are included. Historical payloads with extra upload/audio values are unsupported. Require exact consumption, not padding from defaults or discarding excess values.

read_only.description: True for serialized frontend-injected slots without editable schema inputs: PREVIEW_3D image and LOAD_3D buttons. Preserve these values during import/projection, but reject writes before mutation. Omitted for schema-backed fields and writable seed companions. Absence or false does not override active-branch, ambiguity, selector-switch or other write checks.

identity.description: Structural serialization path: field name, ancestor choice, child field name, and optional owning-field companion. Mutually exclusive branches may reuse names but have distinct identities. A companion's owner is its identity path without the final companion component, never an adjacent position or its bare name. LOAD_3D buttons precede their owner; seed companions follow it. Identity does not imply edit permission, including for the injected PREVIEW_3D image slot.

options.description: Present for dynamic selectors only. An empty list means explicitly declared zero choices, not unavailable metadata. A typed dynamic selector without an explicit options list rejects catalog generation with its class and field identified. Keys must be unique strings within this selector; consumers must check key uniqueness explicitly because JSON Schema validation alone does not enforce it. Field and choice array order is semantic and covered by catalog_version. Unsupported key types are rejected during generation, never coerced. Consumers must reject unknown selections.

catalog_version.description: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON encoding of `types` alone (sorted keys, no whitespace, UTF-8), prefixed 'sha256:'. Excludes itself and class_count, so a consumer holding only the catalog can recompute it. Deterministic for identical object_info regardless of key order; any change to any class's widget order or grow family moves it. Consumers pin and cache on this.

class_count.description: Number of entries in `types`. Redundant with the map's size; present so a consumer can sanity-check a truncated transfer without walking the map.

types.description: One entry per node class the loaded environment knows. EVERY class is present, including widget-less ones: a missing entry ('unknown class') and an empty widget_order ('no widgets') are different statements and a converter must distinguish them. Invalid or unavailable dynamic selector options and unsupported nesting reject the entire catalog with class/field context; generation does not silently skip classes or return a partial catalog.

widget_order.description: First-choice display order from Graph.widget_order_default. Includes nonserialized injected controls. This is NOT a decoder for arbitrary widgets_values: dynamic selectors may choose another branch. Use widget_layout for serialized participation and branch-aware identities.

autogrow_templates.description: Present only for classes with a COMFY_AUTOGROW_V3 input: base input name -> element-naming template. The schema's own template when object_info ships one, else the pluralization fallback the edit path applies ('images' -> prefix 'image'), so a consumer holding only the catalog can name grown slots without object_info.

prefix.description: Grown slots are '<base>.<prefix><N>', N from 0. Mutually exclusive with 'names'.

names.description: Verbatim element names by index; past the end, growth continues as '<names[-1]><N>'. Mutually exclusive with 'prefix'.

inputcount.description: Present only for the kijai 'inputcount' family (ImageBatchMulti, JoinStringMulti, ...). NOT autogrow: the schema declares fixed '<elem>_N' inputs plus an INT widget the node reads at runtime, so bare 1-based '<elem>_N' keys are the wire address and growing one also means WRITING that widget.

widget.description: The widget to bump when a slot is grown (always 'inputcount').

elements.description: Element bases with a '<elem>_1' input, sorted (e.g. ['image']).

stale.description: True when object_info came from the on-disk cache because the server/session was unreachable. The catalog is still usable — catalog_version identifies WHICH snapshot it is — so this is a warning, not an error.

warnings.description: Non-fatal advisories; carries the 'object_info_stale' entry when stale is true.
